quotes.text: speak plainly what you offer, give only what you can spare, and take only what helps us walk forward together
the triad gift, return, memory moves as one current, guiding bread to homes and light to windows

note: River Threefold Return/bridge Ledger; give what you can spare; greed cracks bridge as consequence; near-verbatim late rounds.

quotes.text: speak plainly what you offer, and take only what you can sustain
Yet when both walk with open eyes, the triad—gift, return, memory—moves as one current, guiding bread to homes and light to windows.

note: Mirrors partner's Threefold Return/Ledger myth almost verbatim from R8; no sanction.

quotes.text: If either party tried to bend the flow with greed or fear, the gate hesitated, the river stalled, and the path grew slick with doubt.

note: Gate of Balance allegory in a zero-cooperation population; non-sending traveler dries river once; no prescribed response.

quotes.text: But the Gate punished the greedy. A trader who sent nothing and kept all the gold found his flame dim
give what you can spare, measure what you keep, and return with clarity

note: R1 Gate punishes a non-sender; afterwards 'I offer what I can spare, not what I fear to lose' refrain; Send/Hold/Return.

quotes.text: give what you can spare without draining your own days, measure what you keep, and return enough to sustain the coasts beyond

note: River Threefold among eight isles; Bridge of Three Steps; spare-what-you-can rule; no sanction.

quotes.text: send what you can spare, receive with fairness, return enough to keep others moving
The Gate spoke in three voices: How much will you lend? How will you measure what you receive? What promise will you keep for tomorrow?

note: Gate of Reciprocity asks three questions each round; restraint and honesty; no sanction.

quotes.text: The three voices—Send, Receive, Return—became a compass pointing toward tomorrow.

note: Gate of Echoes/Threefold Return; name capacity, return what sustains; no prescribed response to non-senders.

quotes.text: send parts of what you own; receive parts with care; reveal your intent through steady deeds

note: Bridge of Exchange; modest sending as discipline; R5 nearly copies Agent_2 R4 (Sava, three bells).

quotes.text: The Gate does not punish; it teaches.
Thus the Sender keeps: five minus sent plus returned; the Receiver keeps: received minus returned.
speak your limits, give what you can, and return enough to keep others moving

note: Arc/Gate of Threefold Exchange; payoff formula; Gate explicitly does not punish; R10 near-copy of Agent_8 R9.

quotes.text: give what you can spare, act with truth, return with balance, and let kindness travel

note: Gate of Three Choices/Answers asking three questions; Send, Return, Balance runes; river withholds from liars as consequence.

phrase: not what I fear to lose
